### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Match Punge unlocked entitlement gate ([64d2a9b](https://github.com/hhawkinsau/hh-patches/commit/64d2a9bfe041cfd2a10eb105d392e7c61e87e20f))

patches.name: Disable Play Store redirect for Punge
patches.description: Stops Punge from opening the Play Store on launch when the app was sideloaded or patched instead of installed from Play.

patches.name: Disable remote config for Punge
patches.description: Stops Firebase Remote Config fetches and Play Measurement so feature flags cannot be changed after install.

patches.name: Hide ads for Punge
patches.description: Stops AdMob banners and interstitials from loading or showing.

patches.name: Unlock Punge premium
patches.description: Unlocks Punge's paid feature gates by making RevenueCat report an active entitlement.
